verdict.rationale: Batch mode documents FAILED and PARTIAL job states and per-file FILE_FAILED and FILE_SKIPPED states. Unsupported extensions are skipped with a documented UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA error code, and files are processed independently, so one bad file doesn't sink the job. Missing for 10: a documented error-code catalog beyond UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA, retry guidance (retryable vs. permanent errors, backoff), explicit fail-fast/timeout behavior for corrupt files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
